svg.title: AI Command Gateway: Optional model adapter - ARCH-003 v0.1
svg.desc: An explicitly selected optional OpenAI adapter receives bounded observations. Dry run avoids transmission. Local validation accepts exact claims or returns a labeled local fallback. No execution interface is exposed.

g.text: Fixture-tested transport - no live inference verified - no execution authority
